identificationModule.officialTitle: Effectivity of Extracorporeal Cytokine Adsorption (Cytosorb) as Additive Treatment of CAR-T Cell Associated Cytokine Release (CRS) Syndrome and Encephalopathy Syndrome (CRES)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* severe CRS (\> 3) and / or severe CRES (\>3)

AND

- CRS/CRES onset \< 6 hrs

Exclusion Criteria:

* Heparine allergy
* contraindication for anticoagulation
